note: Per-league fits (football-data.co.uk, season 2024-25; ESPN day-pull leagues as labelled per fit). 'systems' holds pooled two-tier country fits (shared strengths/Elo scale, per-tier rates) used ONLY for cross-tier fixtures no single league fit holds; each system carries its walk-forward validation against the separate fits. 'cups' holds pooled cup fits (Round 3): one walk-forward pool per cup family, gated by a bar stated in each pool's 'gate' block — only a pool with gate.ships true may price. 'no_source' records the competitions proven to have no match-level results source, with their evidence. 'control' is the EPL fitted by this same code for comparison against the shipped v5-soccer.json; the checker never prices from control — EPL prices from v5-soccer.json exactly as before.
